method: TypeScript AST import/dynamic-import reachability; PostCSS source layers/declarations; lexical variable/utility/public-path references. Not runtime visibility, tree-shaking or deletion proof.
limits: Token-name references on admin/shared files do not prove customer-value inheritance; surface/root scope controls values.
Import closure includes type and dynamic imports and all group TS entry files; it is not runtime tree-shaking, route/state coverage, or removal proof.
CSS @imports are listed separately in ownership report; external vendor styles and legacy CRA files are outside this AST graph.
Public asset literal search omits manifests, dynamic paths and existing external URLs; no-match is not deletion permission.
